78201.subject: Two Circuits Now Disagree About Kalshi
78201.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Ninth Circuit](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/ninth-circuit-says-kalshi-sports-contracts-aren-t-swaps-splitting-with-third-circuit)**[ says Kalshi’s sports contracts aren’t swaps, splitting with the Third](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/ninth-circuit-says-kalshi-sports-contracts-aren-t-swaps-splitting-with-third-circuit)

* **[An attacker](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/attacker-drains-more-than-usd1-million-from-avici-users-in-live-solana-neobank-attack)**[ drains more than $1 million from Avici users in a live Solana attack](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/attacker-drains-more-than-usd1-million-from-avici-users-in-live-solana-neobank-attack)

* **[Solana validators](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-validators-approve-doubling-disinflation-in-first-governance-vote-with-kraken-reversing)**[ approve doubling disinflation after Kraken flips late](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-validators-approve-doubling-disinflation-in-first-governance-vote-with-kraken-reversing)

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-drops-below-usd78-000-after-warsh-speech)**[ drops below $78,000 after Warsh’s first Jackson Hole speech](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-drops-below-usd78-000-after-warsh-speech)

* **[Ethena](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-plans-equity-perpetual-basis-trades-for-usde-backing)**[ plans equity-perpetual basis trades to back USDe](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-plans-equity-perpetual-basis-trades-for-usde-backing)

Two federal appeals courts have now read the same sentence of the Commodity Exchange Act and come to opposite conclusions about the same company’s product.

The Ninth Circuit ruled Friday that Kalshi’s sports event contracts [are not swaps](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/ninth-circuit-says-kalshi-sports-contracts-aren-t-swaps-splitting-with-third-circuit), affirming the dissolution of the injunction that had kept Nevada from enforcing its gaming laws. Judge Ryan Nelson wrote that whether the Super Bowl happens is the occurrence of an event, while whether a particular team wins it is the outcome of one, and that Kalshi’s broader reading “knows no limiting principle because anything could be defined as an event.” The Third Circuit held in April that the same contracts do qualify as swaps, leaving New Jersey preempted.

Kalshi now runs an identical product under state gaming enforcement in Nevada and federal shelter in New Jersey. Both rulings came on preliminary injunctions, and neither ends the underlying case. A split like this one, on a single company’s product, is the classic route to the Supreme Court.

78200.subject: Vibe trading
78200.body:
View this post on the web at https://uniswap.substack.com/p/vibe-trading

Correlated pairs: how AMMs win the biggest markets
As AMMs like Uniswap have grown, their liquidity has organized into a pattern most of finance hasn’t noticed yet: correlated pairs. Hayden’s new essay [ https://substack.com/redirect/b19d5cd5-1512-4786-a83d-48140cb836ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] looks at the rise of tokenization and what it means for market structure.
We know, we know: tokenization’s mainstream moment is already here. The SEC has approved Nasdaq and NYSE to trade tokenized shares. DTCC, which settles nearly every security in America, ran a live trial of tokenized trading in July. Nearly all of that activity gets described as an infrastructure upgrade. That’s true, but it buries the bigger story. Tokenization makes markets programmable, changing what markets exist, who makes them, and what those markets trade against.
Liquidity follows correlation. The deepest markets onchain are pairs that move together, because LPs in those pools take on less risk. Stablecoins got there first. Stocks are up next. Ten tokenized stocks now trade against SPY on Robinhood Chain. They did $35M in volume from 11K traders in their first twelve days.
This is what AMMs were made for. Passive liquidity has no overhead to cover, and for pairs that move together, cheap wins. People still ask whether AMMs can win the biggest markets. Maybe the better question is how much of the market will reorganize around AMMs. Read the full article. [ https://substack.com/redirect/6d46f61b-a9d8-4e48-9dae-ad8fcce4691e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] 
Community news
Hood morning: This week, Uniswap passed $20B+ [ https://substack.com/redirect/5c6c9d86-78ef-406d-941e-b141fab66dbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] in volume on Robinhood Chain, including $1B+ across 190+ Robinhood Stock Tokens. About 60% of tokenized equity volume is trading outside US market hours. I guess it turns out that when markets stay open, people use them that way. 
Permissioned pools, explained: How do tokenized funds and securities trade on a permissionless protocol? The Permissioned Pools standard [ https://substack.com/redirect/2469ea35-4b7c-44c0-8986-30001abe249e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] lets issuers apply their own rules directly to a v4 pool, so only approved wallets can swap or provide liquidity. A deep dive on the mechanism behind the new standard, here [ https://substack.com/redirect/ce82c2ec-e777-4c5a-9e6c-6b451f15350f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ].

Caption: 

# Friday charts: Farewell to America's bipartisan icon of optimism

Dolly Parton was bright and bubbly. Her high heels, long nails, and big hair were exuberant. Her glittering outfits were a little girl’s dream.

She smiled constantly and laughed a lot. She was always ready with a joke, always at her own expense.

Her speaking voice was mountain-twang friendly. Her singing voice was high-pitched innocence. 

The songs she wrote were catchy, their hooks and melodies irresistible.

The words, though. The words could be harrowing. 

Her song “The Bridge” told a heartbreaking story of a teenage woman abandoned by a lover who had gotten her pregnant out of wedlock. The song ends — abruptly and unsentimentally — with the ashamed woman jumping from the bridge where they had first met: 

“_[Here is where it started](https://genius.com/38569751/Dolly-parton-the-bridge/Here-is-where-it-started-and-here-is-where-ill-end-it)_

_[And here is where I'll end it](https://genius.com/38569751/Dolly-parton-the-bridge/Here-is-where-it-started-and-here-is-where-ill-end-it)__._“ — 

“Down from Dover” tells the story of another young woman who senses that her stillborn daughter knew her father had abandoned them:

“_She'd never have a father's arms to hold her_

_And dying was her way of telling me_

_He wasn't coming down from Dover_“ — 

It was “one of my best songs ever,” Parton said. Released in 1970, radio stations refused to play it because it depicted pre-marital sex.

An autobiographical note in another song was even darker: “Being born was the worst and the first mistake I ever made.”

This was the woman behind the glitter. Musician, movie star, businesswoman, and philanthropist, Parton was first and foremost a songwriter.

The songs she wrote were stories and she wrote them from experience.

“I used to write a lot of sad-ass songs,” she said. Sad, she explained, because “that's how I grew up.” 

How she grew up was mountain poor.
